Cribbage

Settings

How to play

Goal: be first to 121 points.

Discard: keep 4 of your 6 cards and send 2 to the crib. The dealer scores the crib.

Cut: a starter card is turned up. A jack gives the dealer 2.

Pegging: take turns playing cards to a running total of 31. Hit 15 or 31 for 2, make pairs (2, 6 or 12) or runs, and take 1 for a go or the last card.

Counting: 15s are 2 each, pairs 2, runs 1 per card, flush 4 (5 with the starter), nobs 1.

Tap Hint for a suggestion.
